# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability in this service

Report vulnerabilities in Audio Plugin Soko-kun itself (this repository and https://audio-soko-kun.allegromoltov.jp) privately through [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/AllegroMoltoV/audio-plugin-soko-kun/security/advisories/new). Do not open a public issue for a vulnerability.

## Reporting a malicious or dangerous plugin

To report a plugin listed on Audio Plugin Soko-kun, follow the steps on the [Report](https://audio-soko-kun.allegromoltov.jp/report?lang=en) page.

## Scope of the checks

Audio Plugin Soko-kun checks plugin files against a database of known malware samples, verifies build provenance attestations, and inspects the contents of zip archives. A plugin that passes the checks is not guaranteed to be safe. See [Security and disclaimer](https://audio-soko-kun.allegromoltov.jp/security?lang=en).

---

本サービスの脆弱性は、公開の Issue ではなく [Private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/AllegroMoltoV/audio-plugin-soko-kun/security/advisories/new) で報告してください。掲載中のプラグインの問題は、[通報](https://audio-soko-kun.allegromoltov.jp/report) のページの手順で報告してください。
